register.labelZh: LISTEN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: listen in 可以幫助你描述有人暗中聽取私人談話、通話或會議的情況。；等待門鈴、警報、自己的名字或其他重要聲音時,可以使用 listen out for。；老師、教練、導遊或領隊需要大家專心聽時,經常會使用 listen up。；這些表達可以幫助你分辨暗中偷聽、等待特定聲音和專心聽取指示。
register.summaryEn: Listen in helps you describe situations in which someone secretly hears a private conversation, call or meeting. Listen out for is useful when you are waiting for a doorbell, an alarm, your name or another important sound. Listen up is common when a teacher, coach, guide or leader needs everyone’s full attention. These expressions help you distinguish secret listening, waiting for a sound and giving someone your full attention.

Use listen out for somebody/something when someone is waiting to hear a particular person, sound or message. Listen up is often used as a direct request or order to pay close attention.
